meaning: A picture works if it actually shows what it says it shows: each of the 10,106 dogs as one field in its registered coat colour, grouped by the dog's year of birth and ordered dark to light within each year, with the undetermined count matching the drawing.

items.why: Every dog is drawn in the same flat grey and the count of undetermined coats reads 0, so the coat colours the subtitle promises never reach the fields.
The coat colours appear and are sorted dark to light, but the whole register is one block with a clipped sex label ('...lich–iblich') instead of rows grouped by year of birth.
Same as W02: colours are shown but all dogs sit in a single block labelled 'männlich', not grouped by year of birth as the subtitle claims.
The year grouping is right but 8,572 of 10,106 dogs are counted as undetermined and the rest are mostly grey, so the colour field is clearly being misread.
All fields are flat grey with 0 undetermined, and the rows are grouped by age 0–15 rather than by year of birth.
Identical to W01: correct year bands but every dog is the same grey, so no coat colour is shown.

Same as W04: it is grouped by year, but 8,572 dogs come out undetermined and almost no colour shows, so the colour mapping is broken.
